name: Best hunter pets
summary: No single pet suits everything: families differ in damage, survivability and utility. These are the recommended picks by activity.
steps: Levelling: Cat for fast, strong damage (less durable later), or Boar for durability and Charge
Raids and dungeons: Cat for top damage, or Wolf for Furious Howl (party melee AP) and 1.2 sec attack speed
PvP: Broken Tooth (rare cat, Badlands, 1.0 sec attack speed, about 7-8 hour respawn), Wind Serpent (Lightning Breath ignores armour, ranged)
Organised PvP: Crocolisk (Dismember healing reduction), Bat (Sonic Blast vs casters), Bird of Prey (Mine! disarm)
Solo endgame: Wolf (Furious Howl threat) or Boar (survives sustained damage)
tips: Wolves are great in groups without a Warrior's Battle Shout

name: Hunter pet loyalty & training
summary: Pets earn Loyalty as you adventure together, from Rebellious to Best Friend. Loyalty gives Training Points, spent in Beast Training to learn and rank up abilities; feeding and killing with your pet raises Loyalty and keeps it happy.
steps: Loyalty ranks: Rebellious, Unruly, Submissive, Dependable, Faithful, Best Friend
Feed your pet and kill mobs together to raise Loyalty
A level 60 Best Friend pet has 300 Training Points
High-level tames can start with negative Training Points
Learn active abilities by taming a pet that has them and using them in combat until you see the 'learned' message
Pets can have at most four active abilities
Pet Trainers teach passives (Great Stamina, Natural Armor, resistances) and Growl (every 10 levels)
tips: Check the Pet Trainer every level
Resetting abilities costs a small fee
After learning from a temporary pet, abandon or stable it before training your main pet

name: Zephras Isle walkthrough (Skyborne 1-12)
summary: The Skyborne starting island, from Thendal Village through Shen'dar Village, Valanaar and Shadowgale Forest to the showdown with the Al'Aketh cult.
steps: Coming of Age (Ailee Farheart), Harmony in Balance and Infestation Investigation in Thendal Grove
Harvesting Windstones (15 Windstone Clusters) earns a gathering profession voucher
Elemental Unrest in the northern valley; touch the Leyline and Elemental Convergences for a racial buff
Kill the Cirrusfly Queen (48, 28)
Foul Matriarch and Aggressive Encroachment: Urs'anah in the bear cave (38, 27), group advised
Al'Aketh Thugs and Malduko Cloudcrush in the south-west ruins
The Adventurer tent (42, 45) and The Great Outdoors (Raan Wildwind)
Faction Elder: Illaya Amberwind (Horde) or Rathiril Sunlance (Alliance)
Highlands Bandits and Badwind Bennic in the west
Hippogryph Harassment and A Little Beauty; Matriarch at (35, 54)
Elite Vulgara from the north side of her hill (43, 52), soloable around level 7
Infiltrating the Cult at Falaath Village: Stormcallers and Commander Cyclas
Western Watch chain: Commander Aanders
To Valanaar and Deliver the Signet
Gustberry Lowlands faction chains and Crab Season
Windfield Orchard quests with Aamelia Windfield
Shadowgale Forest chains, then the Nightclaw Cavern healing quest and the final battle
tips: Walk on Air and Blessing of Zephras tornadoes (40% speed) for fast travel
Windstones heal and restore mana on Zephras Isle
Don't jump off the wind bridge until the wind appears
Wait for talk-and-wait scenes to finish

name: Skyborne (new race)
summary: An elf race descended from Highborne who hid in the Skywall and took up air magic. Alliance Skyborne are the High Order; Horde Skyborne are Windshapers. They start on Zephras Isle and need a WoW Forever upgrade pack.
steps: Unlocked by the Heroic Pack, Epic Pack, Warcraft Forever Collection or Collector's Edition
High Order (Alliance) classes: Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue, Warrior
Windshaper (Horde) classes: Druid, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warrior
Start in Thendal Village, Zephras Isle (to about level 12-14)
Riding and Galestrider mounts at Fairweather Stables (54, 81)
Skycutter ship from Valanaar to Dalaran (Alliance) or Thunder Bluff (Horde)
tips: Racials include Walk on Air (steerable slow fall), Wind Blessed (haste), Elemental Insight, plus Read Ley Line (High Order mana cooldown) or Skysight (Windshaper speed)
Faction reputation discounts mounts and riding: 5% at Friendly up to 20% at Exalted
Skyborne can speak Darnassian across factions
